nom: medicube Zero Pore Blackhead Deep Cleansing Oil

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily spots or sebaceous filaments report the oil helps some with blackheads and sebum, though a few say it left an oily film that would not wash off before switching products.
segments.dry: Several reviewers describe the product drying out their skin badly, causing dry patches around the mouth, and one explicitly warns against use on dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some report no burning, no irritation and even relief from fragrance sensitivity, while others say the smell bothers them or that it dried out and worsened breakouts.
segments.combination: One reviewer with a few oily spots developed new acne after starting use, describing the product as unsuitable for skin that did not previously break out.
segments.mature: A reviewer who noticed more blackheads with age says the product worked only slightly and less than hoped.

concerns.aging: One reviewer who developed more blackheads and clear-skin loss with age reports only slight improvement, less than expected.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report the product left their skin very dry with dry patches, though others describe it as moisturizing and non-stripping; effect is inconsistent.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers note no burning or irritation even on sensitive skin, but this is not widely discussed.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers describe a greasy film that would not rinse off or emulsify, while others say it rinses away cleanly with no residue.
concerns.spots: Reports are mixed on blackheads specifically: several reviewers describe visible reduction in blackheads and sebaceous filaments over time, while others (including one testing it on the chest) saw an increase in blackheads and no change at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement in cystic flare-ups, but several others describe new pimples, worsened acne, or purging-like breakouts starting shortly after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers generally describe the product as cutting oil and residue well, though one reviewer felt it left the face still oily and hard to rinse clean.

aspects.libelle: Smooth soft skin feel after rinse
Good value for price and longevity

extraits.texte: I love a good oil cleanser and this one genuinely is amazing at removing makeup especially waterproof mascara. But after a few weeks i noticed a lot more black heads and breakouts. My skin is very sensitive and acne prone but it did make my face look less dull after washing with it. I also used it on my chest as I get black heads in that area and i did break out and saw an increase of black heads after using in that area :(
This completely dried out my skin and i had dry patches all around my mouth. It did clean off my makeup though. Don't recommend for dry skin.

This product works great. Like any product you have to use it more than once to see results but you will see results if you use it daily. You rub the oil into your pores for at least a minute then add a little water to activate it and continue to rub it all over ,then rinse it all off and finsih with their face wash. You may end up getting more acne for a bit because you face it purging its impurties which is typical with any cleansing products. Soybean is considered risk free, Unless your allergic to soy.

Have totally fallen in love with this cleanser. Use it to take off my makeup and then double cleanse with a water based one after. I have noticed a pretty visible reduction in blackheads and sebum. I am extremely acne prone and this hasnt broken me out at all. 10/10!

Even though the bottle is eighteen dollars.I used maybe a dime size of the product and it did my whole entire face.My face felt so smooth.It wasn't bread or irritated afterwards.As every other face was that i've ever used and I have sensitive skin.I will be a repeat customer.

extraits.titre: don't use if you didn't need it before
extraits.texte: I tried this product a few months ago because I have always had a few oily spots on my face, but ever since then I have had acne I never had before and it will not go away. Don't feel tempted to use it just because you want to add an extra step to your routine. A simple face wash will do.

Love how it doesn't sit weird on my face. I've had issues whwre it was super oily , and it felt like it wouldn't wash off. I have visibly noticed less blackheads and sebaceous filaments on my nose. Love how it smells! Not overpowering
